frontierDefinitions.frontier: Highest contiguous floor with at least one win; retries can change turn-order seed.
frontierDefinitions.reliableFrontier: Highest contiguous floor won under every sampled seed.
frontierDefinitions.majorityFrontier: Highest contiguous floor won under at least half of sampled seeds.
frontierDefinitions.floor100Wins: Direct summit samples, not proof that earlier floors were cleared.

baseline.note: Baseline uses the same tactical, flower, fairy, adaptive-crystal and five-potion policy.

summit.assumptions: Seven obtainable parties; four qualities; pilot/tank/adaptive crystal; 10 seeds each. Ideal rolls are supplied fixtures, not a measured acquisition time. Uses the same real engine and legal frame assistance.

limits: Not an exhaustive search of all obtainable parties, gems or command policies.
Sampled wins are not human population win rates.
No playtime or farming-time guarantee. No player stats modified.
